field.name: co_military_exemption_55_to_64
field.comment: At 55 and over a retired servicemember uses the pension and annuity subtraction instead (DR 0104AD line 4; C.R.S. 39-22-104(4)(f)): $20,000 at 55-64, less Social Security subtracted on line 3. Same figure as co_pension_subtraction_55_to_64 (Income Tax Topics: Military Servicemembers, Feb 2025).

field.name: co_military_exemption_65_plus
field.comment: At 65 and over a retired servicemember uses the pension and annuity subtraction (DR 0104AD line 4): $24,000, less Social Security subtracted on line 3. Same figure as co_pension_subtraction_65_plus.

field.name: co_military_exemption_under_55
field.comment: Colorado military retirement benefits subtraction for a taxpayer 54 or younger at year end: the lesser of $15,000 and the taxable military retirement benefits (DR 0104AD line 7; C.R.S. 39-22-104(4)(y); 2025 104 Book p. 19).

field.name: co_military_retirement_exemption
field.comment: Colorado subtraction for military retired pay (computed per taxpayer by co_military_retirement_exemption): under 55 the $15,000 military retirement subtraction (DR 0104AD line 7); 55-64 and 65+ the pension and annuity subtraction, $20,000 and $24,000 (line 4), applied here to the military pay alone (#1330).

field.name: co_military_retirement_taxable
field.comment: CO taxable military retirement after exemption (computed)

field.name: co_pension_subtraction
field.comment: CO pension/annuity subtraction (computed based on age)

field.name: co_pension_subtraction_55_to_64
field.comment: CO pension/annuity subtraction for taxpayers age 55-64 (2025). Source: Colorado DOR

field.name: co_pension_subtraction_65_plus
field.comment: CO pension/annuity subtraction for taxpayers age 65+ (2025). Source: Colorado DOR

field.name: co_tax_rate
field.comment: CO flat tax rate 4.40% (2025). Source: Colorado DOR

field.name: co_taxable_income
field.comment: CO taxable income after all adjustments
